title: Toledo — Equation Library of the Human–AI Readout Programme
description: The permanent, coded registry of every equation in the Human–AI Readout Programme together with its Coq (Th_coqc) formalisation. Th_coqc certifies that a lemma is closed under a stated finite model's global context — an internal-consistency check, never an empirical or physical truth claim. v1.3 merges 34 newly registered readings from the deposited paper 'Effort Across Stochastic, Controlled, and Adaptive Worlds' v0.3 (10.5281/zenodo.22622206) under the weld, EQ-015 and A.5 roots (946 entries total, 592 root rows) and ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and command-line client (19 tools over stdio, a SQLite/FTS5 search index, and a static read API published on GitHub Pages) that lets an AI agent look an equation up before using it. Each entry carries an honest coq_status (closed, definition, wrapped_related, mapped_not_wrapped, open_prop, or not_formalisable). Scope: equations and Th_coqc only; papers, books and prose live in their own records and cite Toledo codes.
